Not retired and never will be. Grounds closed: environmental monitoring exceedance, where a variance lever could not carry a ranking and could not carry a banded verdict either (the golden tier took both values across 40 seeds) and where eleven estimator forms spread 0.52 mg/L against 0.04 permitted; and crime incidence hotspot analysis, where ten candidates died on paper screens and the survivor, true incidence behind the reporting-and-recording filter, failed identification outright. That last measurement is the slot's best output: the profile over the reporting level is flat from 0.10 to 1.00 within 0.08 log-likelihood units, so true incidence is pinned only to 38.0 to 367.3 per 1,000 households, about 8,200 times the printed precision, and state dependence does not rescue it. Four results from this slot are rules in the skills: the correction dichotomy, the distance-to-boundary refinement, the ratio-of-totals qualifier, and the case-two non-invariance test. Whoever resumes it starts at stage 1 on a new ground, runs the dichotomy and the non-invariance profile before the six screens, and reads the six rejection lines in the handoff first.
